packageRules.description: The base image automerges at every level short of a major, and without a schedule. GitHub refuses jobs to a runner more than 30 days behind the current release, and ARC registers runners with self-update disabled, so a bump that waits for a human is a countdown to the scale sets on nuc01 going quiet. The gate is the build workflow: the image is built and checked (tools, uid, runner version, a cgo compile) before Renovate may merge. From there k3s-nuc takes over, with its own pull request for the new tag and digest.
The actions in the build workflow, pinned by digest. They run on hosted runners in a public repository and only build this image; the build itself is the test.
